dedupe_keys.name: comprehensive retail network dataset of bangladesh shop locations products and sales targets

description: This data set maps a national network of 719,817 small retail shops across Bangladesh, the outlets through which packaged consumer goods reach households, with their locations, types and the sales targets a supplier sets for them. It links three CSV tables: shops with GPS coordinates, administrative units, type, style, importance and visit frequency; 42 product variants across five brands and nine types with packet sizes and prices; and monthly sales targets for 17 products at 613,656 shops. The producers are Md Mahmudul Hasan Shahin, Jannatul Ferdous Swarna and Dewan Farid, who collected it between February 2022 and October 2024 through field surveys, company records and expert input and describe it in Data in Brief. Coverage is all 8 divisions, 64 districts and 515 sub-districts of Bangladesh. The files are free on Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the network belongs to one distributor's sales force and the product category is not named beyond brands, flavours and packets, so the shop list represents that company's coverage, not all food retail; sales targets are plans, not observed sales. Simulation uses: last-mile distribution network models for packaged food and essential goods, estimating which shops and populations a flood or road closure would cut off, and routing of replenishment after a disaster. Related records: the New York State retail food stores list (data-nys-retail-food-stores) is a regulator's register of food outlets for comparison.
